name: fillet-box-four-uprights
description: A 40 x 30 x 10 mm box with its four upright edges rounded by 5 mm, so the four rounds meet the top and bottom. Checked by hand: volume 12000 - 4 x (25 - 25 pi/4) x 10; area: top and bottom 2 x (1200 - 4 x (25 - 25 pi/4)), sides 2 x 30 x 10 + 2 x 20 x 10 (each 10 mm shorter), rounds 4 x (pi x 5/2) x 10; 10 faces, 24 edges, 16 vertices.
